column2: Ohohohohoho!
Welcome, $$大神官$$ $$ヨハネ$$—
or should I say, now that you're wanted, just another filthy old fool!
Beautiful women?!
B-beautiful women??
You're as rude as ever, aren't you?
Lord $$ユダ$$, renowned for his $$嫉妬$$, would never concern himself with women!
They are... undeniably $$可愛い$$ men!!
More importantly, did you enjoy the
armored assassin I so thoughtfully arranged for you?
She is such a pitiful girl.
Even after her $$お師匠さま$$ was captured, she kept researching alone...
Until she finally became a victim of that research and apparently put on a $$邪道騎士$$'s armor herself!
And because of it, that armor is draining her $$生命力$$...
They say she has little $$余命$$!
Perhaps you knew all along, didn't you?
That the $$邪道騎士$$ armor she wore, and the $$大邪神$$ armor here...
are cursed armors that steal the $$生き血$$ of whoever wears them?!
She was so worried about you, she begged you again and again to stop your research...
but you would not even listen to that poor girl.
Hee hee... Isn't that right?
Back then, I was kind enough to listen to her troubles.
My, my... From the looks of it, I don't see her with you.
Oh! Don't tell me... you killed the poor thing?!
W-who would hand it over to the likes of you?!
Ever since I served at your side, I've been so envious of you, I could scarcely stand it!
Being envied by others is the surest proof that one has superior abilities!
You... were always the ruler of this city, the one people envied...
Everyone watched you with burning, admiring eyes...
And on top of that... you even had a woman who would sacrifice her own life for you...
All I wanted was the position of ruler of this city!!
That is why I went to such trouble getting close to you...
using the armor research as a pretext to have you sent to prison!
Did you truly never realize it until now?!
Either way... it is all over for you!!
Even for people like you, this many of us...
You are... $$ルピルピ$$?!
You survived... and you betrayed me?!
Grrr! How infuriating! That is why I hate real women so much!!
My $$可愛い$$ $$愛人$$s, do away with them!
